scope: Read-only static architecture triage during frozen full source producer. No runtime, owner, profiler, maintained writes or test execution. Counts are source-level lower bounds for stated paths, not timings.
recommendation: Prioritize a coherent prepared-owner wrapper composition unit spanning base, table, legacy, browser, checker and inventory, including the actual title prior and inventory prior-bound metadata predicate. Replacing a browser/checker tool leaf alone leaves the dominant structurally duplicated prepared-guard recurrence in place. Do not apply a partial graph or merge distinct instances; first capture and prove exact real dependency nodes, their scopes, projections and final boundaries.

exact_prepared_recurrence.basis: inventory-reference-owner.mjs wrapPrepared defines assertPrior, then returns browser.wrapPrepared(checker.wrapPrepared(inventory-wrapped prior)); checker-reference-owner.mjs, browser-reference-owner.mjs, legacy-removal-canonical-stage.mjs and table-local-compilation-canonical-stage.mjs each return assertCurrent and prior_metadata_assert_current as the same assertPrior function. base-class-removal-canonical-stage.mjs captures and calls priorGuard and metadataGuard separately, both pointing to the same table assertPrior on this specific chain.
exact_prepared_recurrence.recurrence: For wrapper n whose prior exposes both names as the same actual function, one wrapper assertPrior calls that same prior guard twice and its own actual local assertCurrent twice. No path/value-based dedup assumption is needed.
exact_prepared_recurrence.limits: Counts exclude constructors, sourceLane projection reads, nested metadataRead guards, outer guarded selected calls, callback reentry, native guards, inventory prior-bound loop, error branches and other distinct objects. They describe this specific complete alias chain and a successful call only; verify identities in actual runtime controls, never generalize a wrapper with distinct prior guard functions.

inventory_obligation: inventory-reference-owner.mjs assertPrior additionally iterates priorBound and verifies hash(metadataRead(path)) before final local guard. These projected per-path checks are a distinct real predicate, not redundant solely because assertCurrent and prior_metadata_assert_current alias. Title prepared prior returns two different guards: one does ctx/prior/ctx; the other also revalidates prior.bound through ctx.metadataRead. Both must remain represented, with genuine before/after frame authority and snapshot/descriptor checks.

theming_analysis.count: 11 theming-chain tool constructors from theming through remainingUnthemable; context also owns separate title source and 11 independent source transactions.
theming_analysis.structure: Each tool factory builds a local bound as local refs concatenated with successor.bound, then calls its own assertCurrent once during construction; a leaf reference is consequently reread in each ancestor local bound. For chain length N, a unique leaf member occurs in N constructor guard sweeps; total concatenated reference visits are sum over levels, quadratic in N under bounded per-level local roster.
theming_analysis.not_a_claim: These factories do not recursively call successor.assertCurrent in their assertCurrent bodies. currentThemingTools creates a legacy owner and separate repairs instance and its guard calls legacy once, repairs twice, prior once and own bound sweep; context.assertTools instead directly uses sourceLane, a separate repairs instance and its own bound loop, not currentThemingTools.assertCurrent. Do not call the theming chain itself exponential or claim a measured dominant hotspot.

comparison.prepared_chain: Offers explicit repeated same-object/function opportunities with an exponential-in-wrapper-depth structural recurrence; preserving all distinct predicates/projections requires a full coherent scope, not merely replacing duplicate calls blindly.
comparison.inventory: Opaque inventory is the bridge required to connect the prepared chain: it owns checker and browser subcontexts, real metadata projections, prior-bound map checks and CI physical refs. Factoring it must represent these actual predicates and dynamic boundaries. An inventory-only partial plan that treats opaque neighbors as empty cannot safely flatten the whole path.
comparison.browser_checker_tools: Their individual local tool/owner guards may benefit from node interfaces, but small leaf conversion alone does not collapse the 32/16 repeated wrappers or the opaque inventory and prior metadata work. Make them dependencies of the coherent unit once predicates are proved; do not spend a separate full-owner attempt to infer benefit from leaf-only changes.
comparison.11_theming_chain: Bound concatenation and repeated independently created source/repair objects are real source costs, but distinct instances are not safely mergeable by same paths or equal values. A separately scoped linearization of actual same-instance successor dependencies may help construction later; do not claim it fixes prepared-wrapper recurrence.

safe_design_constraints: Capture actual same prepared objects and their guard/node identities, never deduplicate by path, source name, equal values or cached result. Preserve distinct priorGuard vs priorMetadataGuard when they differ, and inventory priorBound projected-read checks even when function identity matches elsewhere.

Per invocation, run callback-free preflight for all genuine participating frame/source/population/absence/loaded-identity/descriptor scopes; run each required local consumed reader/judgment with physical-before/supplied/physical-after or authenticated logical projection mapping, then callback-free finals after the last callback.

Maintain public source facade/standalone guard behaviors, mixed/opaque fallback and private registration authority; handle alternate-scheduler same-node reentrancy and cross-node nesting. No new reader grants, source/current-result/receipt caches or production monkeypatches.

Prove cold restoration, late cross-owner drift, changed population/absence, inspector/accessor poisoning, projected byte forgeries and nested operations in real per-object controls, then unchanged original complete source CLI cold/late coverage and the genuine full owner under original deadlines.
limitations: No current runtime, timing, speedup, fraction of 1800s, or success probability measured. V9 timeout does not identify a unique hotspot.
The requested unit is architectural recommendation, not an implementation-ready claim that every legacy/inventory predicate has already been factored.
No G11, source-owner, packed/floor, audit or canonical-transaction pass.
